title: Expose the graph through a read MCP tool and the contract (additive)
goal: NERV and any MCP client can read the graph from the live index
acceptance: A `work_graph` read tool (`readOnlyHint`, loopback only like the others) returns the payload of T02 as `structuredContent`, with each node linked to its file at its commit and the snapshot time; an optional repository filter
Additive: the three existing tools and the contract `version` stay as they are; docs/SOLUTION.md's live index contract has a new row, and a test fails if the existing three answers change
The answer's size on the nine checkouts is recorded; if it passes the 8000-character text limit the contract says clients read `structuredContent` (as for `waiting_on_me`)
A test across the service and a real MCP client call: a graph with a critical path, a problem entry for an unreadable repository
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One more read tool next to the three that exist, and one more contract row; no change to the existing tools. Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
